You are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">CC Immune</> while Channeling.
KeysToEntries.Hecate.PSV.InGame.Long2: Can move while channeling. Channel will not be interrupted if the target or Hecate get out of range.
KeysToEntries.Hecate.PSV.InGame.Long3: Structure buff area has infinite duration. Only 1 Structure can be buffed at a time. If a new one is buffed the previous one will lose the effect.
KeysToEntries.Hecate.PSV.InGame.Long4: Must complete the ritual on a player within {PlayerWindow} seconds of that player getting a kill.
KeysToEntries.Hecate.PSV.InGame.Short:
You may interact with things to empower them.

  • Interacting with an allied Structure creates a<keyword tag="Keyword.Buff"> zone which regenerates health and mana</>
  • Interacting with an ally who has recently killed a god will increase both your and that ally’s <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Strength and Intelligence</>
KeysToEntries.Hecate.PSV.OutOfGame:
You may interact with things to empower them.

  • Interacting with an allied Structure creates a<keyword tag="Keyword.Buff"> zone which regenerates health and mana</>
  • Interacting with an ally who has recently killed a god will increase both your and that ally’s <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Strength and Intelligence</>.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A01.InGame.Short:
Blow a breezy projectile that explodes when it hits an enemy, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</> in a small area.

  • Damaged enemies are also <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slowed</>
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A01.OutOfGame:
Fire a projectile that explodes on the first enemy hit. The explosion deals <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slows</> enemies in the area.

  • Damaged enemies are also <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slowed</>
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A02.InGame.Long: Movement Speed Buff is applied as 4 stacks, stacks are lost one at a time.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A02.InGame.Short:
Summon the wind to become <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">Slow Immune</> and gain <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Movement Speed</> that fades over time. 

  • Activate this within a Whirlwind to <keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Dash</>, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slowing</> enemies hit
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A02.OutOfGame: Summon the wind to become <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">Slow Immune</> and gain <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Movement Speed</> that fades over time.   • Activate this within a Whirlwind to <keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Dash</>, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slowing</> enemies hit
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A03.InGame.Long: The Whirlwind attempts to apply the effect every 0.35 seconds for 4 seconds.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A03.InGame.Long2: Damage over Time is refreshed on each hit.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A03.InGame.Long3: Damage over Time hits 6 times over 2.5 seconds.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A03.InGame.Short:
Create a Whirlwind, which spreads onto all enemies that enter its area.

  • Affected enemies repeatedly take <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</> over time, even if they leave the area
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A03.OutOfGame:
Create a Whirlwind, which spreads onto all enemies that enter its area.

  • Affected enemies repeatedly take <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</> over time, even if they leave the area
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A04.InGame.Long: Projectile passes through and damages all enemy targets, and passes through walls.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A04.InGame.Long2: Enemies are Displaced up and away from the projectile.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A04.InGame.Short:
Summon the Spirit of the Nine Winds to deal <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</> in a large path.

  • Enemies hit are also <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Knockback">Knocked Back</>
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.A04.OutOfGame:
Summon the Spirit of the Nine Winds to deal <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</> in a large path.

  • Enemies hit are also <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Knockback">Knocked Back</>
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.PSV.InGame.Long: This effect does not scale off Base God Mana.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.PSV.InGame.Short: As you build items that provide Mana, you gain bonus Intelligence.
KeysToEntries.Kukulkan.PSV.OutOfGame: As you build items that provide Mana, you gain bonus Intelligence.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A01.InGame.Long2: Stealthed gods are invisible to enemies unless they enter an enemy structure's attack area.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A01.InGame.Long3: Taking damage while in Stealth partially reveals you for {RevealDuration} seconds.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A01.InGame.Long4: You are Immune to Slows while Stealthed.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A01.InGame.Long5: Stealth is broken when hit by Hard CC.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A01.InGame.Short:
Disappear in a puff of smoke, become <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Stealthed and gain Movement Speed.</> 

  • Your next basic attack deals additional <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> over time
  • Killing a god resets the cooldown of this ability
  • You are Immune to Slows while Stealthed
KeysToEntries.Loki.A01.OutOfGame:
Disappear in a puff of smoke, become <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Stealthed and gain Movement Speed.</> 

  • Your next basic attack deals additional <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> over time
  • Killing a god resets the cooldown of this ability
  • You are Immune to Slows while Stealthed
KeysToEntries.Loki.A02.InGame.Long: This ability hits {AttackCount} times over {DeployableDuration} seconds.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A02.InGame.Long2: Blinded players have their game camera obscured.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A02.InGame.Long3: The Vision Impedes enemy characters only.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A02.InGame.Long4: Loki benefits from Behind You on Blinded enemies from all directions.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A02.InGame.Short:
Summon a vision of Loki that repeatedly deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> to nearby enemies.

  • Damaged enemies have <keyword tag="Keyword.Debuff">reduced damage</>
  • Enemies hit four times are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Blind">Blinded</>
KeysToEntries.Loki.A02.OutOfGame:
Summon a vision of Loki that repeatedly deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> to nearby enemies.

  • Damaged enemies have <keyword tag="Keyword.Debuff">reduced damage</>
  • Enemies hit four times are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Blind">Blinded</>
KeysToEntries.Loki.A03.InGame.Long2: Slow is refreshed with each hit but does not stack.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A03.InGame.Long3: This ability can benefit from Behind You.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A03.InGame.Short:
Unleash a flurry of dagger strikes, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> repeatedly and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slowing</> enemies in front of you.   
  • The final hit deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{FinalDamage_Formula} [{FinalDamage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and applies a stronger Slow  
  • This is a Channeled ability  
  • You are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">Displacement Immune</>  while Channeling
KeysToEntries.Loki.A03.OutOfGame:
Unleash a flurry of dagger strikes, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> repeatedly and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slowing</> enemies in front of you. 

  • The final hit deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage"> bonus Physical Damage</> and applies a stronger Slow
  • This is a Channeled ability
  • You are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">Displacement Immune</>  while Channeling
KeysToEntries.Loki.A04.InGame.Long: Loki locks onto the enemy god closest to the center of the teleport location, if there is one.
KeysToEntries.Loki.A04.InGame.Short:
<keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Teleport</> to the target location, then strike twice to assassinate a foe.

  • The first strike deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Cripple">Cripple</> enemies in the area
  • The second strike deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{FinalDamage_Formula} [{FinalDamage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Stun">Stuns</> enemies in front of you
KeysToEntries.Loki.A04.OutOfGame:
<keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Teleport</> to the target location, then strike twice to assassinate a foe.

  • The first strike deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Cripple">Cripple</> enemies in the area
  • The second strike deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Stun">Stuns</> enemies in front of you
KeysToEntries.Loki.Basic.InGame.Long2: Has a 5 hit chain. Attacks in order of 1, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 1.5x damage and swing time.
KeysToEntries.Loki.PSV.InGame.Long: The increased damage from this effect also triggers on enemies Blinded by Agonizing Visions
KeysToEntries.Loki.PSV.InGame.Short: Hitting enemies from behind deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">bonus damage</>.
KeysToEntries.Loki.PSV.OutOfGame: Hitting enemies from behind deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">bonus damage</>.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A01.InGame.Long: Projectile passes through and damages all enemies, and passes through walls.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A01.InGame.Short:
Fire a Spirit Arrow projectile that deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Rooted">Roots</> enemies.

  • This ability detonates Weaves that it hits
  • This arrow passes through everything
KeysToEntries.Neith.A01.OutOfGame:
Fire a Spirit Arrow projectile that deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Rooted">Roots</> enemies.

  • This ability detonates Weaves that it hits
  • This arrow passes through everything

KeysToEntries.Neith.A02.InGame.Short:
Unravel the world weaves, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Damage</> to enemies in an area.

  • This ability creates a Weave
  • You <keyword tag="Keyword.Heal">Heal {Heal_Formula} [{Heal_Scaling_Percent}] Health</> for each enemy  hit
  • Hitting a god <keyword tag="Keyword.Heal">Heals for {HealLarge_Formula} [{HealLarge_Scaling_Percent}] Health</> instead
KeysToEntries.Neith.A02.OutOfGame:
Unravel the world weaves, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> to enemies in an area.

  • This ability creates a Weave
  • You <keyword tag="Keyword.Heal">Heal</> for each enemy  hit
  • Hitting a god <keyword tag="Keyword.Heal">Heals</> for more
KeysToEntries.Neith.A03.InGame.Long: This ability can Leap over walls, as long as you can reach a valid landing area.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A03.InGame.Short:
Deal <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slow</> enemies in front of you, then <keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Leap</> backwards.

  • This ability detonates Weaves that it hits
KeysToEntries.Neith.A03.OutOfGame:
Deal <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slow</> enemies in front of you, then <keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Leap</> backwards.

  • This ability detonates Weaves that it hits
KeysToEntries.Neith.A04.InGame.Long: Damage scales linearly from 50% to 100% based on Channel time.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A04.InGame.Long2: Channel for 0.5 seconds for minimum damage, or for 2 seconds to deal fully charged damage.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A04.InGame.Long3: Projectile ignores minions, passes through walls.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A04.InGame.Long4: Enemy gods can step in front of this projectile to be hit by it instead of the selected god.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A04.InGame.Long5: You can cancel this ability anytime before firing, the costs and cooldown will not be consumed.
KeysToEntries.Neith.A04.InGame.Short:
Charge up and fire an arrow across the world, locked on to an enemy god and ignoring obstacles.

  • The arrow deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{CTScaling_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Stun">Stuns</> 
  • You can fire the arrow before it is fully charged, but it will deal less damage
KeysToEntries.Neith.A04.OutOfGame:
Charge up and fire an arrow across the world, locked on to an enemy god and ignoring obstacles.

  • The arrow deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Stun">Stuns</> 
  • You can fire the arrow before it is fully charged, but it will deal less damage
KeysToEntries.Neith.PSV.InGame.Short:
Your abilities either create or detonate Weaves.

  • Detonating Weaves deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> to nearby enemies and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Rooted">Roots</> them
  • You gain a <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">stacking Attack Speed and Intelligence increase</> per Weave detonated
KeysToEntries.Neith.PSV.OutOfGame:
Your abilities either create or detonate Weaves.

  • Detonating Weaves deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> to nearby enemies and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Rooted">Roots</> them
  • You gain a <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">stacking Attack Speed and Intelligence increase</> per Weave detonated
KeysToEntries.Odin.A01.InGame.Short:
<keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Leap</> forward, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> to nearby enemies as you land.

  • If you have a Shield from Raven Shout, it explodes upon landing
KeysToEntries.Odin.A01.OutOfGame:
<keyword tag="Keyword.Movement">Leap</> forward, dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> to nearby enemies as you land.

  • If you have a Shield from Raven Shout, it explodes upon landing
KeysToEntries.Odin.A02.InGame.Short:
Gain a <keyword tag="Keyword.Shield">{Shield_Formula} [{ShieldScaling_Scaling_Percent}]Health Shield</> for a duration.

  • After the duration, the Shield explodes dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage equal to the remaining Shield Health</> to nearby enemies
  • If the Shield is at full HP when it explodes, it deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} Physical Damage</> instead 
  • While the shield has HP, you deal <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{PulseDamage_Formula} Physical Damage</> around you every second.
KeysToEntries.Odin.A02.OutOfGame:
Gain a <keyword tag="Keyword.Shield">Health Shield</> for a duration.

  • After the duration, the Shield explodes dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage equal to the remaining Shield Health</> to nearby enemies
  • If the Shield is at full HP when it explodes, it deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Bonus Physical Damage</>
  • While the shield has HP, you deal <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> around you every second.
KeysToEntries.Odin.A03.InGame.Long: Projectile passes through and damages all targets but stops on walls.
KeysToEntries.Odin.A03.InGame.Short:
Charge up, pulsing damage around you twice, then throw your spear.

  • The pulses deal <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slow</>
  • The spear deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{SpearDamage_Formula} [{SpearDamage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Stun">Stuns</> if fired after two pulses. Can only stun the first god hit
  • If you refire the spear early, nearby allies get <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Attack Speed</> and this ability has a 20% reduced cooldown
KeysToEntries.Odin.A03.OutOfGame:
Charge up, pulsing damage around you twice, then throw your spear.  

  • The pulses deal <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slow</>  
  • The spear deals <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">Physical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Stun">Stuns</> if fired after two pulses. Can only stun the first god hit 
  • If you refire the spear early, nearby allies get <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Attack Speed</> and this ability has a 20% reduced cooldown
KeysToEntries.Odin.A04.InGame.Long: Ring of Spears does not block ally movement or projectiles, only enemy basic attacks and enemy god movement .
KeysToEntries.Odin.A04.InGame.Long2: The Ring is made of 8 Segments that each have 5 Hit Points, an enemy basic attack will deal 1 Hit Point per hit.
KeysToEntries.Odin.A04.InGame.Short:
Create a spear ring of walls that impedes enemies. Enemy gods who die in the ring grant Odin a permanent STR and INT buff. Max 10 Stacks. Gain a stack of Path to Valhalla. 

  • Enemies in the area <keyword tag="Keyword.Debuff">cannot Heal, and have reduced Strength and Intelligence</>
  • Enemies who leave the area take <keyword tag="Keyword.Damage">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Physical Damage</> and are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slowed</>, unless exiting through segment of the ring destroyed by basic attacks
KeysToEntries.Odin.A04.OutOfGame:
Create a spear ring of walls that impedes enemies. Enemy gods who die in the ring grant Odin a permanent STR and INT buff. Max 10 Stacks. Gain a stack of Path to Valhalla.

KeysToEntries.Odin.Basic.InGame.Long2: Has a 4 hit chain. Attacks in order of 1, 1, 1, 1.5x damage and swing time.
KeysToEntries.Odin.PSV.InGame.Long: This can trigger off allied or enemy god deaths, and has no max range.
KeysToEntries.Odin.PSV.InGame.Short: When a god dies, gain a brief increase to <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Movement Speed, Strength, and Intelligence</>.
KeysToEntries.Odin.PSV.OutOfGame: When a god dies, gain a brief increase to <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Movement Speed, Strength, and Intelligence</>.
KeysToEntries.Sol.A01.InGame.Long: Pool scales from 1x radius at 0 Heat to 2x radius at 100 Heat.
KeysToEntries.Sol.A01.InGame.Long2: This ability hits {AttackCount} times over {DeployableDuration} seconds.
KeysToEntries.Sol.A01.InGame.Short:
Create a pool of flames and <keyword tag="Keyword.Heal">Heal</> yourself over time for <keyword tag="Keyword.Heal">{Heal_Formula}%</> of your missing Health.

  • Enemies in the pool take <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</> repeatedly
  • The size of the pool increases if you have more Heat when using this ability
  • You gain Heat when using this ability
KeysToEntries.Sol.A01.OutOfGame:
Create a pool of flames and <keyword tag="Keyword.Heal">Heal</> yourself over time for a percentage of your missing Health.

  • Enemies in the pool take <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</> repeatedly
  • The size of the pool increases if you have more Heat when using this ability
  • You gain Heat when using this ability
KeysToEntries.Sol.A02.InGame.Long: Projectile stops and explodes on first enemy hit, walls, or max range.
KeysToEntries.Sol.A02.InGame.Long2: Can only trigger ability based items and effects.
KeysToEntries.Sol.A02.InGame.Short:
Your next basic attack fires a projectile that explodes on hit or upon reaching max range, then retracts, and generates Heat.

  • Both the explosion and the retraction deal <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slow</>
KeysToEntries.Sol.A02.OutOfGame:
Your next basic attack fires a projectile that explodes on hit or upon reaching max range, then retracts, and generates Heat.

  • Both the explosion and the retraction deal <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</> and <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Soft.Slow">Slow</>

KeysToEntries.Sol.A03.InGame.Long2: This Immune state is Damage Immunity, Healing Immunity, CC Immunity, Untargetable, and makes you able to pass through allies, enemies, and Impediments.
KeysToEntries.Sol.A03.InGame.Short:
Gain <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Movement Speed and Slow Immunity</>, gaining Heat and leaving a trail of fire behind you.

  • The Trail deals <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</>
  • After 3 seconds, you become <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">Immune</> and unable to attack, and the trail detonates dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{ExplodeDamage_Formula} [{ExplodeDamage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</>
KeysToEntries.Sol.A03.OutOfGame:
Gain <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Movement Speed and Slow Immunity</>, gaining Heat and leaving a trail of fire behind you.

  • The Trail deals <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</>
  • After 3 seconds, you become <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">Immune</> and unable to attack, and the trail detonates dealing <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</>
KeysToEntries.Sol.A04.InGame.Long: Areas are selected every 0.18s or when your targeter has moved more than 1.8m since the last area was selected.
KeysToEntries.Sol.A04.InGame.Short:
Unleash flame and fury, gaining Heat and striking 8 times along a moveable ground target location.

  • Each strike deals <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">{Damage_Formula} [{Damage_Scaling_Percent}] Magical Damage</>; subsequent hits deal reduced damage
  • The first time an enemy is hit, they are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Hard.Knockback">Knocked Back</>
  • You are <keyword tag="Keyword.CC.Immunity">CC Immune</> while using this ability
KeysToEntries.Sol.A04.OutOfGame:
Unleash flame and fury, gaining Heat and striking 8 times along a moveable ground target location.

  • Each strike deals <keyword tag="Keyword.DamageMagical">Magical Damage</>; subsequent hits deal reduced damage

KeysToEntries.Sol.PSV.InGame.Long2: Heat starts depleting if you have not generated Heat within the last 6 seconds.
KeysToEntries.Sol.PSV.InGame.Long3: Heat depletes over time at a rate of 3 heat per 0.33s.

Hit enemies with basic attacks or use abilities to gain Heat.

  • Heat grants increased <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">Strength, Intelligence, and Attack Speed</> from items
  • At Max Heat, increase your <keyword tag="Keyword.Buff">basic attack damage</>
KeysToEntries.Sol.PSV.OutOfGame:
Hit enemies with basic attacks or use abilities to gain Heat.
